title: setup inside a worktree names the wrong project
what: relay setup run inside a git worktree either refuses or names the project by its main checkout, and writes no .bak file into a tracked folder.
why: 25 Oct, the arsenal pilot design, scratchpad reports/design-arsenal.md (copy in ~/.relay/backup/scratch-3207dc59), section 1.1: setup in .worktrees/relay-setup would name the project after the worktree and leave .bak files in tracked folders. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen); needed at the pilot's setup step.
failing_case: relay setup --relay-folder in a temporary repo's linked worktree: the project name is the worktree's folder name; a .bak appears beside a tracked file.
pass_cases: The same run names the main checkout's project, or refuses with what to run; no .bak in a tracked folder.
